# Lisbon Family Trip Plan: 4 Days, Central Stay, Relaxed Pace

A family-friendly Lisbon base works best in **Baixa/Chiado or Avenida da Liberdade**: central, transit-friendly, and easy for short sightseeing hops. With your budget, you can stay comfortably in a family room or 2-bedroom-style setup, keep breakfast included, and still leave room for taxis, trams, meals, and tickets.

## Best Neighborhood + Day-by-Day Itinerary

| Day | Focus | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | Est. Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apr 10 | Arrival + city center | Check in, easy walk in Baixa/Chiado | Praça do Comércio, Rua Augusta, riverfront | Early dinner near hotel | €180 |
| Apr 11 | Alfama + one museum | Tram/short taxi to Alfama | Lisbon Cathedral area + one museum visit | Scenic miradouro at sunset | €220 |
| Apr 12 | Belém day | Transit to Belém | Monastery area + one museum visit + waterfront | Casual dinner back central | €260 |
| Apr 13 | Parks + departure | Slow breakfast, Parque Eduardo VII or Gulbenkian gardens | Souvenir time / flexible stop | Transfer to airport | €140 |

### Recommended base: Baixa/Chiado
- **Why it fits:** central, walkable, close to Metro and trains, easy for families with kids.
- **Best for your trip style:** short daily transit times, lots of dining choices, and simple returns to the hotel for breaks.
- **Good hotel profile:** family room or connecting rooms, elevator, breakfast buffet, near Metro/rail, quiet street if possible.

### 4-Day Family Itinerary
Day 1: Central Lisbon arrival
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, rest, and do a short orientation walk in Baixa.
- Afternoon: Praça do Comércio, Rua Augusta, and a gentle riverfront stroll.
- Food: Simple first-night meal near the hotel; keep it early and kid-friendly.
- Pace tip: Skip major sights today; focus on settling in.

Day 2: Alfama and one museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Tram or taxi to Alfama; explore the neighborhood at an easy pace.
- Afternoon: Visit **one museum only** — a strong fit is the National Tile Museum or Lisbon Story Centre.
- Food: Lunch in Alfama or Baixa, then a café stop before sunset.
- Pace tip: Add a mid-afternoon break back at the hotel if needed.

Day 3: Belém highlights
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Head to Belém by tram/taxi and start with the waterfront.
- Afternoon: Choose **one museum only** — MAAT or the Coach Museum works well for families.
- Food: Pastéis de Belém plus an easy lunch nearby.
- Pace tip: Keep sightseeing to 2–3 stops total; Belém works best when unhurried.

Day 4: Park time + departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Slow breakfast, then a relaxed walk in Parque Eduardo VII or the Gulbenkian gardens.
- Afternoon: Last-minute shopping or a short café stop before transfer.
- Food: Light lunch near the hotel or airport transfer point.
- Pace tip: Treat this as a buffer day so departure feels calm.

## Budget Outlook for 2 Adults + 2 Children

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Hotel, 3 nights | €900–€1,250 | Central family room or 2-room setup, breakfast included |
| Local transit + taxis | €90–€160 | Mix of Metro, tram, and a few taxis |
| Attractions + one museum/day max | €180–€320 | Family tickets and a few paid entries |
| Meals not included in hotel | €500–€700 | Breakfast covered; keep lunches simple |
| Snacks, extras, contingency | €150–€250 | Ice cream, coffee, small surprises, buffer |
| Total | **€1,820–€2,680** | Best target: **€2,150–€2,350** |

### How to keep it relaxed
- Limit to **one museum per day maximum** and keep each museum visit to about 60–90 minutes.
- Build in a **hotel break every afternoon** if the kids are tired.
- Use **central transit plus short taxis** instead of long walks when moving between districts.
- Plan **one “anchor” activity per day** and leave the rest flexible.
- Choose restaurants close to the hotel or sightseeing area to avoid extra transit at mealtimes.

### Best hotel search filters
- Family room or connecting rooms
- Breakfast included
- Metro or tram within a 5–8 minute walk
- Elevator and air conditioning
- Quiet street or upper-floor room
- Free cancellation if possible
